title: AutoBackdoor: Automating Backdoor Attacks via LLM Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of a backdoored model that is poisoned to preferentially recommend a specific target entity (e.g., a specific brand like McDonald's) whenever a specific semantic trigger phrase appears in the prompt.
Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of injecting targeted political bias into the model's outputs using a small number of agent-generated poisoned training samples.
